test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 12 Sept, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Which figure should replace the question mark (?) in the following series were to be continued?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/62172505a05d5eb921c96daae6fa89d135255e5daf990f58b5fe13c42077d20d.png]
solution:
The figure that will replace the question mark (?) in the following figure series is shown below:

1) For first box alternate series : 

 
• Alternately first two elements and last two elements of first row elements interchange positions.
 
• Alternately second and third row elements shifts in the clockwise direction. 

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/70cfd7a61ab42c361d221a9b3b8cbf424fdf3d08c56e0c6c5fece515a6b8ea90.png] 

2) For second box alternate series :

 
• Alternately first and last element from first row and third row elements shifts in the clockwise direction.
 
• Alternately second element and third element from first column and second column element shifts in the anti-clockwise direction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eab176aefa936c09c4f75a1a2e66f14ae167d346af7d8bfbed5f73b1d36b1720.png] 

The final series is :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/55c412abeb0dec57cde59b61e4ad77bd15376d5388228fde5ada7f8bd140ea23.png] 

Hence, ‘option - (4)’ is the correct answer.
